description: Join us for a walking tour of Broadwater Farm (BWF) Estate & see up close the first new council homes built on the estate in 50 yrs. The tour will also incl. a visit to the historic England‑listed BWF Mosaic currently being restored, as well as the recently improved BWF community centre. To be delivered in collaboration with BWF stakeholders inc. Residents’ Ass, Harmony Gardens & The Lordship Rec.

events.name: Drop in: Broadwater Farm Estate Tour

factsheet.heading: Broadwater Farm Estate Tour
paragraphs: Join us for a walking tour of Broadwater Farm Estate and see, up close, the construction of the first new council homes built on the estate in 50 years. The tour will also include a visit to the historic, England‑listed Broadwater Farm Mosaic currently being restored, as well as the recently improved BWF Community Centre. We are also hoping to collaborate with the Broadwater Farm Residents’ Association as part of this event.
